usage audience

  • CURIE: gmeow:usageAudience
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageAudience
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/names
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The audience or scope in which the appellation is used — an Agent, a Group/Family, or a locale community. Range is gmeow:Entity to admit all of them. Non-functional. ('Aunt Genny' is used toward the family; 欧德理 toward a Sinophone audience.)

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NameUsage -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:usageAudience from gmeow:NameUsage to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:NameUsage, gmeow:Entity

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to record who a name is used TOWARD — the social scope of a gmeow:NameUsage, an agent, group/family, or locale community.

Avoid when

  • Avoid conflating audience (who the name is used toward) with gmeow:usageAuthority / gmeow:accordingTo (who ASSERTS the usage claim) — the social scope and the standpoint frame are orthogonal axes; use gmeow:usageRelationshipScope when the scope is exactly one standing relationship.

How to use

  • Add one or more gmeow:usageAudience entities to a NameUsage (non-functional); for a single tie, prefer gmeow:usageRelationshipScope, and keep the standpoint on gmeow:usageAuthority / gmeow:accordingTo.

Examples

  • ex:usageFamily gmeow:usageAudience ex:family.
